title.quote: O PEN FAKE: An Open Dataset and Platform Toward Real-World Deepfake Detection
title.value: OPENFAKE: An Open Dataset and Platform Toward Real-World Deepfake Detection

extractions.description: The paper introduces OPENFAKE, a large politically grounded dataset of ~3M real images (from LAION-400M, filtered and captioned with Qwen2.5-VL) and ~963k synthetic images from 18 modern generators, plus OPENFAKE ARENA, a crowdsourced adversarial platform. It benchmarks deepfake detectors (SwinV2-Small trained on OpenFake, GenImage, Semi-Truths; ConvNeXt/DRCT, EfficientNet-B4/FF++, CLIP-D-10k+, Corvi2023, zero-shot InternVL3-38B), reports a human perception study, and an in-the-wild social media evaluation.

type.quote: An experimental study which shows the weak performance of detectors trained on the currently available datasets on detecting realistic deepfakes
type.justification: Dataset construction, model training and benchmarking experiments.
